ede2qj14q6o.speaker: narr
ede2qj14q6o.text: On the riverbank, you could see a palace built of wood, with a golden parasol standing in front of it. Whenever the people on the boats around you passed it, they quietly bowed their heads.

ejpol2dlhhpf.speaker: nekmax
ejpol2dlhhpf.text: That's the temporary wooden palace where King Norodom lived until the new palace was ready. We can't see the king's face from here, though.

e1lr4tsr18tes.speaker: piseth
e1lr4tsr18tes.text: My grandpa told me Phnom Penh is the place where the rivers look like they split into four.
e1lr4tsr18tes.scene: おだやかな場面。落ち着いた声で

e195smvkqtqcu.speaker: piseth
e195smvkqtqcu.text: “Four faces.” Boats can come from upriver, from downriver and from the sides. That's why it's a good place for a capital, he says.
